description.en:
Tells whether one player on the pitch has a skill effect with a given type and value. It is the player-only half of CMND_BTL_GET_SKILL_EFFECTIVE.
Each player on the pitch has three effect slots, filled from the skill-effect moves they know (see CMND_BTL_LEARNING_SKILL). Only the first slot of the requested type is looked at; it counts if its value equals the requested value. The result (0 or 1) is written into the output array.
The first argument (team) is read but not used.
Team of the player (0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team). Required but ignored.
Pitch slot (0 to 31) of the player, as given by CMND_BTL_GET_CALC_PARAM mode 1.
Effect type to look for, e.g. SKILL_EFF_PLUS_EFFECTIVE (21), SKILL_EFF_PLUS_CRITICAL (14), SKILL_EFF_SCC_DOWN (15) from ie4_soccer_sys.nut.
Value the effect must have. For SKILL_EFF_PLUS_EFFECTIVE the script passes 0 or the command's element.
OUTPUT: result[0] receives 1 if the player has that effect with that value, 0 otherwise.

Always null. The answer comes back in the output array.
Also null, with nothing written, if fewer than 5 arguments are given.

examples.case: Adding an element bonus from the player's effects (real usage, from ie4_soccer_sys.nut, GetSkillElement)
Critical-hit chance from luck and two player effects (real usage, from ie4_soccer_sys.nut, GetCritialPer)
